_instructions.audio_review: Set reviewed_against_audio=true only after direct playback; then use method=direct-listen and list every reviewed range.
_instructions.keep: May be recorded without evidence, but it remains acknowledged-unverified and does not resolve audit flags.
_instructions.format_text: May change whitespace, trailing sentence punctuation, or equivalent Unicode presentation only; do not use for commands, paths, or identifiers.
_instructions.exclude: Requires evidence.type audio-listen covering the whole segment.
